# customerCode & Owner Identity — Full Code Report

## Critical finding: spec/implementation mismatch

The acceptance test describes a **redesign in progress**. The current `AssignCustomerCode` produces `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007`), but `AcceptanceTest.java` now asserts the customerCode must become **`<REGION>-<HASH8>`** (region + first 8 upper-case hex chars of a SHA-256 hash). The test also brings in SHA-256 helpers (`sha256hex`, `shaHex`) that are not yet used by any main code. So the current implementation does not satisfy the new acceptance test.

---

## 1. The create flow (orchestration)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` wires the `POST /api/owners` pipeline. Order:
`validate -> ensurePostcodeValidForCity -> resolveRegistrationDate -> normalizeAddress -> normalizeTelephone -> ensureCityCapacity -> countDailyRegistrations -> ensureDailyRegistrationLimit -> build -> assignHousehold -> ensureUniqueIdentity -> assignCustomerCode -> assignNamesakeCount -> assignMembershipLevel -> assignMembershipNumber -> assignBulkSignupWarning -> save -> audit -> respond`

Each step maps to a class in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`.

---

## 2. customerCode build logic (current)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java` (lines 16-35)

Format `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`: `city3` = upper first 3 letters of city, `last3` = upper first 3 letters of last name, `sequence` = 1 + count of existing owners whose city matches case-insensitively (via `ownerRepository.findAll()`), zero-padded to 4 digits with `String.format("%s-%s-%04d", ...)`. Runs before save, so the created owner is excluded from the count.

```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
    String city = owner.getCity();
    String city3 = first3(city);
    String last3 = first3(owner.getLastName());
    int sequence = 1;
    for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
        if (city.equalsIgnoreCase(existing.getCity())) {
            sequence++;
        }
    }
    owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d", city3, last3, sequence));
}
private static String first3(String value) {
    return value.substring(0, Math.min(3, value.length())).toUpperCase();
}
```

Note: `EnsureCityCapacity` (lines 15-33, cap 50) uses the same case-insensitive per-city counting.

---

## 3. Membership number and check digit

**Membership number** — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMembershipNumber.java` (lines 12-18). Format `<customerCode>-M<YY>` where `YY` = last two digits of the registrationDate year: `String.format("%02d", owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100)`. Runs after customerCode and registrationDate are set.

```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner) {
    String yy = String.format("%02d", owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100);
    owner.setMembershipNumber(owner.getCustomerCode() + "-M" + yy);
}
```

**Membership level** — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMembershipLevel.java` (lines 13-28).
